summary.he: פרשת כי תצא מתארת את מלחמת האדם ביצר הרע בתוך חיי המעשה. קדושת הבית, השבת אבדה, שמירת הדיבור, חסד עם החלש, גבולות בין הכוחות וזכירת עמלק מצטרפים לדרך אחת של בירור, תשובה והעלאת הניצוצות.
summary.en: Parashas Kee Saitzay describes a person’s war against the yetzer hara within practical life. The sanctity of the home, returning lost property, guarding speech, kindness to the vulnerable, proper boundaries among forces, and remembering Amalek join into one path of clarification, teshuvah, and elevating the sparks.

map.he: יציאה למלחמה → בירור היצר והניצוצות → קדושת הבית והדיבור → חסד ומשפט → זכירת עמלק → תשובה וניצחון
map.en: Going out to war → clarifying the yetzer and the sparks → sanctity of home and speech → kindness and justice → remembering Amalek → teshuvah and victory

entries.en: For you will go to war when you go to a man who is not in order, this is the opposite of his will – I would like it to be so, and he would speak to you, which is not in order. And this is the difference between war, as all war is in order, this is the difference between your will and your will. And this is: you will go to war – when you go to a man who is not in order, these are You have gone against your will. And your God has given it into your hand – that all your desires will be nullified, that you will go according to your will, my fear will be like that and you will return to it – when you are in the midst of your trial, when God will take you away, O "the one who is loyal to Hashem." And this is what the Pharisees thought....

And this is what you have done: And you have returned to him–that you have touched your “what” in your thoughts, that you have bound yourself with your God in your thoughts, for as the word of God has been spoken to you. entries.en: And she wept for her father and her mother, and for days it was forbidden to marry in the wilderness, because the wilderness is the place of sorrow and sighing, since they did not receive the Torah, which is the source of joy, as it is written (Proverbs 17:17): "He who is born a fool is a disgrace to him." For they are like a mere slave to this world, which is full of sorrows and anger and sighing and sorrow, as it is written Likewise (Ecclesiastes 2:1) All his days are like sorrow and pain. Therefore, Israel is forbidden to marry a foreigner, because there is no power in our midst to sweeten the sorrow and sighing of the foreigner....

entries.en: A stranger is the power of mourning and sighing, a harlot woman, who is in her power in the bitterest of trials and so on, 'trials' (from the proverbs) because she has swum to the death of her house, and there is no power in the hand of Israel to sweeten the force of their mourning and sighing, and therefore it is forbidden to marry them, because there is no power to turn them into the holy place in the trial Joy, indeed, will grow in him in the trial of sorrow and sighing that he will be the last of the punishments, and he will be torn from the two worlds of mercy and peace, and he will descend in the sorrow of Sheol.

entries.en: Yivam... and you shall make it for his donkey... it will not be able to disappear and this is the test of the mitzvah of the return of loss, because the return of loss is the test of the breaking of the desire for wealth, because the one who takes the object that he finds that is worth wealth and can take it for himself and he takes it and returns it to its owners is found to be the test of the breaking of the desire for wealth, tzaddikness. In the case of a loss, it is a sabbath, because it is a need. In the case of a grace, it is a great grace, because the grace of grace exceeds the need. (Sukkah 4:11) It is found that the mitzvah of a loss is a sabbath, because it is a sabbath, because the desire for wealth is at hand....

entries.en: tzaddikness and mercy, and by this hand is complete providence extended (as mentioned in the book of the "Simonites," part a-Simanig, Aiyen Sham). This is why the mitzvah of the Sabbath of loss is written in the language of the seer, just as it is written: "You shall not see your brother's ox or his sheep going astray and disappear from them; you shall bring them back again," etc. And so you shall do to his donkey. entries.en: The duty to send the mother is only for the time that it is said that the souls are in exile, for it was for the time that man had not yet attained holiness and purified himself as he should be, and the sparks of his soul were still in great exile. But he could not take the souls with the mother, because the impurity of the copper still clung to the mother. And then the essence His correction, when he is sent, will send the mother, who will be reduced to mere words that are the souls to take, will see that he has not been wise after him at all, he will only speak words as they are and will not understand them with his mind after him to inquire and correct.

entries.en: "Where is the place of His glory?" is the Shekinah, the revelation of the truth, because when His kingdom disappears, He will be blessed as a shield from the heat of the growing power of the peels and the punishment of the afterlife. Who is worthy of believing and knowing that His kingdom is true in all matters, even though the Aqeom, who are the peels, have bowed down to the people of Israel over the rulers, the peels because they are believers. Israel, despite their own sins, also accepts animals. Only from Him will they be blessed, for He will bless all of them and His kingdom in all its glory, only the world, unlike those who accept, which are hidden and hidden, is blessed.

entries.en: They have no wisdom at all, as our late Rabbi (in Simeon's collection of the Moharan's books, part 1) wrote about the verse: "A wicked people, but not wise" - "A people is wise, but not wise." Perhaps it is because the Torah and the truth are for the tzaddik to approach, when they throw away all the wisdom from the grave, as if they had no wisdom. All wisdom is complete. And even when he was gathered in the service of Hashem of hosts to remove from his knowledge all the wisdoms and confusions that bewildered him from day to day, all this wisdom was drawn from the wisdoms of the foolishness that he had been accustomed to from his youth, which were fixed in him as such.

And our rabbis taught this: "Let no evil heart grow within his house, and let no one build a ladder within it. When it is raised, because the fallen souls who are in the camp of the returnees and the strangers, all Their ascent is by the grace of a ladder. For as it is in the physical, so it is in the spiritual. For in the physical, when they need to raise a thing from the earth to the heavens, they raise it by the way of a ladder....

entries.en: The aforesaid atonement is for the aforesaid atonement. And thou shalt not shed blood in thy house, lest the atonement fall from him. For by the atonement being complete with the correction of the aforesaid atonement, by this the words of the atonement are made pure for all, and the souls that fall therein are not as clearly as they fell in the aforesaid Torah, which is atonement for the aforesaid atonement, and thou shalt not shed blood. And so, the fall that will befall will befall those who cry out to save the souls that will not fall, and so, this is in itself a test of what our rabbis, the late, taught, from this, that one should not build a shaky ladder, and so, everything alludes to the fallen souls that will befall.

entries.en: Peace and mercy be upon him, the whole world has fallen, as if he were to think of him (as if the world's ruler said in a time of trouble, peace and mercy) as if he were to say peace and mercy, all the troubles came upon him, peace and mercy, all the wide world. And behold, there is a cloud, whose name is that which says peace and mercy, and because of this his heart is turned away. May Hashem bless you truly and grant you peace, peace and mercy, then be upon him. He can cry out, and the afflictions do not increase upon him, for he is merciful to his shadow, for all the pain and peace are only a shadow behind him. The pain is a pain, a cry, a scream, to give vent to his knowledge, to find the wide spaces even within the heart.

entries.en: One must look at the expansions themselves and bring thanks and acknowledgment at every moment. In truth, within every trouble in the world there is an expansion, in the aspect of “In distress You broadened the way for me” (Psalms 4:2). Our Sages likewise expounded the verse “Surely He will not stretch forth His hand against a ruin” (Job 30:24), and it is written, “He does not arouse all His wrath” (Psalms 78:38). This is the aspect of “Place a space between one flock and another” (Genesis 32:17), which our Sages applied to troubles and exiles: Yaakov intended to leave space between the troubles, so that all afflictions would not arrive in a single mingled mass. This is “Place a space between one flock and another”—between one trouble and another, between one exile and another.

entries.en: And truly, this whole world is less than a grain of mustard seed compared to the great light of the tzaddik and the Holy Torah, for their light is exceedingly great, beyond all price and value; but the essence of the eternal power that the light has to prevent the tzaddik and the Holy Torah from seeing it is nothing but the heat that this world is filled with. Very much to the eyes of man, therefore he blocks them before his eyes from seeing this great and terrible light, and the darkness that prevents all this, considering that they are twofold as above, that prevent from seeing the bright light

entries.en: The tzaddik are like wool in the sight of their Lord. Light and truth in the eyes at its root also extends only from the tzaddik of truth, as if it were illuminated within; yet, from the great heat of the power of choice, man is able to look behind his eyes, mercy and peace, and to fix his eyes only on the waste of this world that is his refuge, until Because of this, the light of the tzaddik and the Holy Torah, from which the root of the light of the eyes is derived, has disappeared and been hidden from us forever. He despises being very wise, shining brightly, so that his eyes may be cut off from this world, in a way that will remain...

entries.en: The law of this world is that it will not stand before His eyes, that it will not stand before them in the sight of Hashem, that the light of the light will be overcome, and then the wonder of the Torah and the tzaddik (which is like a woolen cloth), and then it will be seen that all this world (which is like a flaxen cloth) is as nothing and nothing against the light. This miracle, then, from the beginning, all the obstacles and barriers that separate us will be removed, until they become a great good, until they become complete and miraculously able to receive within themselves the light as above. And this is the grace of God....

entries.en: It is clear that it is forbidden to mix wool and flax together in clothing, because at all times flax (which is the manifestation of the materiality of this world, from which all obstacles arise) is far from wool (which is the manifestation of the light of the tzaddik, from which the essence of the light of the eyes is drawn), then it cannot be worn and hide the light at all; however When the two sides approach and join together, then materialism stands before the eyes and delays more than ever from seeing the light of tzaddikness, until it disappears from us completely, mercy and peace, because the materialism of this world is a barrier before us....

entries.en: And Hashem your God will turn the curse into a blessing for you, all the evil that Hashem has blessed you with, and all the reproach that he has brought upon them, sometimes in the way of reproach, all for great good, so as to teach them tzaddikness and mercy, so that they may return to him in truth, because sometimes when Israel corrupts their deeds, Very, very, until at least there is no trace of the little bit of goodness in them, the wicked, the merciful, the shadow of their power, and if God wills, He will bless them to learn about them the right to be rewarded at the hands of the little bit of goodness in them, in which the mourners will be moved to pity.

entries.he: ושלום וימצאו כנגד זה אלפים פעמים להפך חס ושלום אבל ה'יתברך חפץ חסד הוא ואף־על־פי־כן הוא רוצה בעמו וחפץ להטות עליהם כלפי חסד אז את מבזה בעצמו הוא הנפלאה וחכמתו בטובו ישראל בתכלית הבזיון ואומר עליהם שכבר הם אצשכבר מאחר האמות כל כמו ושלום חס לו קלקלו כל כך.ותכף שה'יתברך מהפך הדבר ואומר על ישראל שהם כמו האמות ממש אזי תכף נתראה אמתת הנקדות טובות שבהם.
entries.en: And peace and they will find, on the contrary, thousands of times to turn mercy and peace, but Hashem, blessed be He, desires mercy, and yet He desires His people and desires to be kind to them as a shield of mercy. But He despises Him in Himself, the wonder and His wisdom in His goodness, Israel in the midst of contempt, and He says of them, "They are greater than the nations." All is as it is, and peace is lost, all is as it is. And it will be that Hashem will bless the one who turns the matter around and says of Israel that they are like the nations of old. Then the truth of the good points in them will be seen.

entries.en: For his evil intention was that by his hand he would arouse the sins of Israel, so that in the midst of Hashem's power, "Blessed is he who is forced to make covenants with him, and to curse them, mercy and peace," as is well known. This is what is written, "And he sat down in the wilderness with his face to the word," according to its translation, and also as Rashi interpreted, who was overcome by the sin of the calf. And he thought that the greatness of sin and the greatness of good and the greatness of the wicked could not possibly be a cause of the wickedness in Israel. But a foolish man does not know this, and a fool does not understand this, until He, until He, the Almighty, shows His mighty mercy upon the very face of the curse, the reverse of the wonders and the tzaddik.

A day's clothing—by day, and a night's clothing—by night. Our teachers said: It will not be difficult for you to return to it every time, for every night your soul ascends to me and I do not delay it. How many debts you owe me. For the sabbath of labor is the sabbath of the soul from the very fact that it is his garment for his skin, it is his covering for himself, and a refuge for his soul in abundance....

entries.en: "The Holy Zohar": Remember that I am not a slave to you, like a dream. "For you must close your eyes from seeing the things that are hidden forever, and then you will be like a king and a free man." For this you have earned, when you do not grieve, and your soul is like a slave and a hired hand, then you must shine on all faces that do not oppress or rob you. Finally, mercy and peace. And this is the lesson: "You shall not oppress a hired worker who is poor and needy, your brother, etc."; and not only this, but you also need to warn: "On his day you shall give his wages, etc.", that you do not say that you will pay the wages of the soul for another day, as is found in you.

entries.en: The sons of men who say: Today is not a day to sin! Today is not a day to study and to work! Who is he who despises and despises every day? This is what the scripture warns: “In its day you shall give its wages,” “in its day it is due,” “and the sun shall not come upon it,” because the seed of the thornbush is to shine forth to pay off debt. Today, in the test of "today if you will listen to his voice," because you have spent a day poor in goodness, because every day the light of the hidden light illuminates, which are in the test of the highest graces that are sustained by the wisdom of the highest, where all laws and all limitations are corrected....

entries.en: And therefore, the Torah warns to give the reward of his actions on his day, because the worker who chooses good deeds and these sparkling points on the hands of his servants, as it were, are all gathered within the treasure that is earned on the hands of his actions, because all good deeds and all the sparks of the holy mitzvos are within the treasure, as stated in the words of our Rabbi Nero Yair and this is The wealth that the worker takes until his action is the test of the sparks that he chooses, and they are gathered within the wealth, and therefore from the wealth acquired through his action, as above. And the wealth is the fulfillment of his soul, because the soul is the root

entries.he: ועל־כן הזהירה תורה לתת שכר פעלתו ביומו כי הפועל שמברר טובות והנקדות הניצוצות אלו על־ידי מלאכתו כנ"ל הם נתקבצין בתוך הממון שמשתכר על־ידי פעלתו כי כל טוב וכל ניצו צות הקדושות הם בתוך הממון כמובא בדברי רבנו נרו יאיר וזהו הממון שהפועל נוטל בעד פעלתו שהוא בחינת הניצוצות שברר והם מתקבצים בתוך הממון ועל־כן משתכר ממוןעל־ידי פעלתו כנ"ל. והממון הוא שלמות נפשו כי הנפש שרש
entries.en: In his day he will be given his reward... And to him he carries his full soul as a standard and is clear in the examination of the skills and beliefs that are required of the sons of men, precisely to complete and correct the work of the Creator and, by means of the clear distinction of good from evil. Therefore, our rabbis, may God bless him and grant him peace, said, "Great is the work that the Holy One, blessed be He, warned him to do, for work is a great thing and a very great correction, for it is the one who reveals the good and illustrates the work of the Creator. Blessed be His name, which would not have been completed, if it were now by His hand."...

What does this see in hanging on the Ilan and the like? They are those who give up their souls on the path of hire. But truly, even if danger takes away a soul, there are no jobs among them, even in the physical sense. With all this, it is a test of danger and a removal of a soul from reality.

entries.en: A wife who is alone receives and experiences completeness, and a man who is always poor, always seeks to comfort a soul, while a man who is rich, always seeks to comfort a soul, (as in the golden bowl of the Moher, part a -Simanset, Ayeen Sham). And when a wife is alone, there is no one who comforts a soul. Therefore, the Torah warns how often to have more mercy on the widow, because She is a very miserable and poor soul, because her entire life is taken from her. Therefore, it is forbidden to mortgage her at all, since her life is very short and all the strength of her life is in the possessions that remain to her from her husband.

Therefore, whoever dies without children, having mercy on the dead, is more deficient than all those who are remembered for the sake of the sheep and the goats in the kingdom of heaven, and his soul remains bound. entries.en: Remember what Amalek did to you on the way, when you came out of Egypt. Amalek was the first of the other desolations, in the wilderness: (Amalek was the first of the nations.) And therefore his war is only as against the first of the house of truth, from whom all generations have dwelt, in the wilderness: (Isaiah 1:1-2) From the beginning. For Amalek would not fight with the small or the great, for with the chief he would be at home by himself.

entries.en: The above is true, that all the correction of the souls of Israel and all the worlds is by his hand: and this is what is written (the words are as follows): (And all the weak among you will be ashamed, etc.), and as our rabbis, the late, demanded (Tanhuma, because she will come out) that she would cut off the tails and throw the scoundrels before her. For the people are like the tzaddik. They are like a fox, because they are foolish to him, because the tzaddik one is the head (Isaiah 9:14), and the little ones who are foolish to him are like a fox. But surely it is better to be a fox and foolish to this tzaddik one who is the head of the true house, than to be a fool to him....

entries.en: The one who was cut off in the way of the foreskin of Amalek is the principle of the foreskin of the foreskin that covers the holy covenant, from which the principle of the disappearance that always provokes the light of the tzaddik to the foundation of the world is established by the hands of the defect of the covenant, which is the test of the foreskin, which is the test that was cut off in the way, which is the test of the defect of the covenant, as it were. And he is stronger than it. The tzaddik need to separate them with mercy and peace, and all the weak among you will be ashamed of you, and you will be weary and weary, and will not fear God. For they are the weak, and the strength in Israel, who wants to be strong over them with more strength, to the end, and to separate them with the unknown, the tzaddik need mercy and peace. The truth is that from there all their life and their hope for victory.)

entries.en: When Hashem your God gives you rest from all your enemies around you, the complete fall of the kelipah of Amalek will be only when Israel comes to the holy rest and inheritance, as it is written: “When Hashem your God gives you rest… you shall erase the memory of Amalek.” As long as the holy rest is not complete, Amalek rises again each time; yet he is subdued again and again through the power of Torah and the tzaddikim, especially the tzaddikim who dwell in the dust and have already entered complete rest.
